content.value_statement: Data resources often lack the definitions and evidence required for registration. This skill structures product specifications, sample controls, and listing materials.
actual_capabilities: Assesses product readiness using generality, deliverability, and repeat-sale criteria.
Defines seven registration elements, including scope, update frequency, delivery method, quality level, and rights.
Drafts a structured data product specification and exchange information form.
Plans representative sample selection, de-identification checks, and supporting explanations.
Organizes ownership, quality, compliance, pricing, and product documents into a listing checklist.
Defines a product catalog with identifiers, prices, versions, status, and resource mappings.
limitations: It does not submit applications, access exchange systems, or obtain registration approval.
Embedded guidance may not reflect the latest rules of every exchange or jurisdiction.
It cannot prove ownership, compliance, quality, or authorization without supporting evidence.
Its de-identification guidance requires qualified human review before any sample is released.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Product Readiness
use_cases.description: Review a data resource and identify changes needed for repeatable delivery and sale.

use_cases.title: Draft Registration Materials
use_cases.description: Create consistent product specifications and exchange information from supplied evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Listing Package
use_cases.description: Check sample controls and assemble the documents required for exchange review.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether this data resource can become a repeatable product. List missing information and the next three actions: [resource description].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for an initial product readiness review.

prompt_templates.title: Define the Seven Elements
prompt_templates.prompt: Define the product name, type, scope, update frequency, delivery method, quality level, and rights from this evidence: [evidence]. Flag unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when the product concept is ready for formal definition.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Registration Documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a data product specification and exchange information form for [product]. Keep both documents consistent and mark every unresolved field.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to prepare review-ready registration drafts.

prompt_templates.title: Audit the Listing Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this listing package against product, ownership, quality, compliance, pricing, and sample requirements. Rank gaps by approval impact: [materials summary].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before submission to a registration body or exchange.

output_examples.input: Assess a monthly company registry dataset delivered as CSV files.
output: Strengths: Repeatable monthly delivery and a defined file format.
Gaps: Field scope, rights evidence, quality report, and permitted uses.
Next step: Confirm authorization before drafting the product definition.

output_examples.input: Define a regional retail index API for exchange registration.
output: Scope: Regional retail index values with documented periods and coverage.
Delivery: Authenticated API with a declared update schedule.
Open items: Quality grade, operating rights, usage limits, and pricing evidence.

output_examples.input: Review a listing package that includes raw customer records as samples.
output: Critical gap: The sample may expose personal information.
Required action: Replace it with a representative de-identified sample.
Review requirement: Obtain privacy and compliance approval before release.

best_practices: Provide current exchange templates, supporting evidence, and a clear target jurisdiction.
Mark unknown facts explicitly and assign an owner for every unresolved item.
Require privacy, legal, quality, and business review before submitting materials.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a single-client service as a reusable product without redesign.
Do not claim ownership, quality, or compliance without supporting documents.
Do not share raw personal, confidential, or commercially sensitive data as samples.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the data source, intended buyers, fields, coverage, update schedule, delivery method, rights evidence, quality evidence, and target exchange.

faq.question: Can this skill decide whether registration will be approved?
faq.answer: No. It can assess readiness and prepare drafts, but the responsible registration body makes the decision.

faq.question: Does resource registration replace product registration?
faq.answer: No. Resource registration addresses rights in the resource, while product registration describes the marketable product.

faq.question: Can it create a de-identified sample?
faq.answer: It can propose a process and review criteria. A qualified reviewer must verify the final sample before release.

faq.question: Does it support every data exchange?
faq.answer: It provides a general workflow. Supply the current rules and forms for the chosen exchange.

faq.question: Can it provide legal or regulatory approval?
faq.answer: No. Legal, privacy, and regulatory conclusions require authorized professionals and current evidence.
